versions.changelog:
openquok-tiktok-slideshow 1.0.1

- Updated onboarding and prerequisites to highlight TikTok account warm-up requirements.
- Added a direct link and clear instructions to follow the TikTok account warm-up guide before posting.
- No changes to code or functionality; only SKILL.md documentation was updated.

Initial release: Easily create and post TikTok photo-carousel slideshows with locked AI character images and text overlays, via the openquok CLI.

- Enables step-by-step channel research, persona creation, and AI image generation workflows.
- Supports text overlays using node-canvas, and integrates directly with TikTok through openquok-core.
- Provides comprehensive onboarding, research, and posting pipeline guidance.
- Requires Node 18+, openquok-core CLI, canvas, and an image provider API key.
- All scripts must be copied (not symlinked) to function correctly.
